caption: The drawing depicts a long, full-skirted dress with a fitted bodice and wide, puffed sleeves that are gathered at the elbows and wrists. The dress is primarily a light brown or tan color and is decorated all over with small, colorful floral patterns consisting of red, pink, blue, green, and white details. There are also white decorative elements resembling small clusters spaced regularly between the floral motifs. The dress has a scoop neckline and features a vertically striped, corset-like design at the waist, created using lines and dots in blue, green, and white. At the bottom, the skirt has a wide, gathered ruffle. To the right, there is a smaller, lightly sketched outline of the same dress, showing the back view; it illustrates the same sleeve and skirt structure, as well as a sash or belt at the waist, but without the detailed coloration or pattern. The paper is a light beige color, and there are no additional objects or background elements in the composition.
title: Dress
